QuestInfo.name: Becoming a Blade Specialist 1
QuestInfo.0: You've reached Lv. 45. Lady Syl wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Is Lady Syl still shaken? She's asked you to return to the #bThe Secret Garden#k to pursue the path of the Blade Specialist.
QuestInfo.2: Lady Syl does not look well, but she does her duty with aplomb. Listen to her instructions on how to become a Blade Specialist.

1.0: You have done well. Not only in your training, but in... everything. You are more than ready to progress.
